Demolition That Shows Up on Schedule, Every Time

c: Mississauga runs on appointments, and demolition here has to keep pace with that. Through Meadowvale, Streetsville and Erin Mills, it’s the standard job — an above ground pool, a deck or a garage torn down ahead of a backyard renovation, booked to a real window instead of a vague day. Along Port Credit and Lakeview’s older streets, it’s structures on established properties that have simply reached the end of their run, cleared with the same attention paid to anything else on a lived-in lot. And for landlords managing multiple rental properties across the city, it’s portfolio demolition — fences, sheds and decks cleared across several addresses under one quote structure and one invoice, each one landing on the date it was scheduled for. The 700+ five-star reviews behind Live Junk Free repeat the same detail more than any other: the crew showed up exactly when they said they would.
